NHCX-1001.title: The recipient's system is not reachable
NHCX-1001.meaning: The exchange could not deliver your message because the recipient's endpoint did not answer, so send the request again once the recipient is reachable.
fix: Mark the case as undelivered. The original request is dead and no answer will come for it.
Once the recipient is reachable, send the request again with a fresh x-hcx-correlation_id. Reusing the old one returns NHCX-1006.
If the failures continue, contact the recipient, or NHCX support.
Check that your registered endpoint is reachable from outside your network over HTTPS.

NHCX-1002.title: The sender is not a registered participant
NHCX-1002.meaning: The exchange does not know the sender named on your message, so register as a participant or correct the sender code before sending again.
fix: Register your organisation as a participant.
Set x-hcx-sender_code to the participant code the registry issued you.
Confirm the code with POST /participant/search.
Send the request again with a fresh x-hcx-correlation_id. Reusing the old one returns NHCX-1006.

NHCX-1003.title: The recipient is not a registered participant
NHCX-1003.meaning: The exchange does not know the recipient your message is addressed to, so correct the recipient code before sending again.
fix: Take the recipient code from processingID in the policy lookup, not from PayerID.
Confirm the code with POST /participant/search.
Send the request again with a fresh x-hcx-correlation_id. Reusing the old one returns NHCX-1006.

NHCX-1004.title: No recipient is registered for the scheme you asked for
NHCX-1004.meaning: The exchange found no recipient registered for the scheme on your message, so take the recipient code from the beneficiary's policy and send again.
fix: Look up the beneficiary's policies and take processingID from the policy you are sending against.
Put that value in x-hcx-recipient_code.
Send the request again with a fresh x-hcx-correlation_id. Reusing the old one returns NHCX-1006.
If the lookup gives no usable recipient for the scheme, contact NHCX support.

NHCX-1005.title: A request header is missing or not valid
NHCX-1005.meaning: The exchange refused your call because a header is missing or holds a value it cannot accept, so fill every mandatory header and send again.
fix: Compare your protected header with the x-hcx protocol headers. Fill every mandatory header.
Generate a new UUID for each x-hcx-api_call_id, and one per request cycle for x-hcx-correlation_id.
Set x-hcx-workflow_id to the code for this stage.
Send Accept, Content-Type and bearer_auth on the HTTP call.

NHCX-1006.title: The correlation id has already been used
NHCX-1006.meaning: The exchange already holds a request with this correlation id, so send the request again with a new correlation id.
fix: Generate a fresh UUID for x-hcx-correlation_id and send the request again as a new cycle.
Link the old and the new correlation id to the same case in your system.
Before retrying after a timeout, check whether the first request got through.
If this keeps happening, see Duplicate or mismatched correlation id.

NHCX-1007.title: The exchange could not process the request's structure or values
NHCX-1007.meaning: The exchange failed while processing your message and points at its structure or values, so check the body, the headers and the sealed envelope before sending again.
fix: Check the body: one payload field holding the compact JWE string.
Check every protected header value against the x-hcx protocol headers.
Rebuild the JWE and confirm it has five parts separated by dots.
Send the request again with a fresh x-hcx-correlation_id. Reusing the old one returns NHCX-1006.

NHCX-1008.title: The exchange had a temporary failure
NHCX-1008.meaning: The exchange failed while processing your message for a reason on its side, so wait and send the request again.
fix: Wait, then send the request again with a fresh x-hcx-correlation_id. Reusing the old one returns NHCX-1006.
Space your retries out. Do not retry in a tight loop.
If the code repeats over a long period, contact NHCX support with the correlation ids and timestamps.

NHCX-1009.title: The exchange failed and recorded the cause in its own logs
NHCX-1009.meaning: The exchange failed while processing your message and the cause is in its own logs, so keep the identifiers and contact support if a retry fails.
fix: Keep the x-hcx-correlation_id, the x-hcx-api_call_id, the timestamp and the full response.
Check the request against the x-hcx protocol headers.
Send the request again with a fresh x-hcx-correlation_id. Reusing the old one returns NHCX-1006.
If it fails again, contact NHCX support with those identifiers.

NHCX-1010.title: No request matches the correlation id on your answer
NHCX-1010.meaning: The exchange holds no request with the correlation id on your answer, so answer on the correlation id of the request you received, or check where that request stands.
fix: Copy x-hcx-correlation_id from the request you received into your answer. Do not generate a new one.
Ask the exchange where the original request stands.
If the original request is gone, your answer cannot be delivered. The sender must start a new cycle.

NHCX-1011.title: The x-hcx-status value is not valid
NHCX-1011.meaning: The exchange refused your message because its status header holds a value it does not accept, so set the status that fits the kind of message you are sending.
fix: Set x-hcx-status from the table above.
Build the value from a constant in your code, not from free text.
Send the message again. An answer keeps the correlation id of the request it answers.

NHCX-1012.title: No message matches the api_call_id you gave
NHCX-1012.meaning: The exchange found no message with the call id you referred to, so use the exact call id you stored when you sent that message.
fix: Store the x-hcx-api_call_id of every message you send, against its case.
Refer to the stored value exactly. For a status check, put it in x-hcx-correlation_id.
Send the message again.

NHCX-1013.title: The request body is empty or not valid
NHCX-1013.meaning: The exchange received a call with an empty body or one it cannot read as a request, so send a body carrying the sealed message.
fix: Send a JSON body of the form {"payload": "<JWE_COMPACT_STRING>"}.
Seal the FHIR bundle and the headers into the JWE before sending.
Log the exact body you send, so an empty body shows in your own logs.
Send the request again with a fresh x-hcx-correlation_id. Reusing the old one returns NHCX-1006.

NHCX-1014.title: The exchange could not deliver the response to its sender
NHCX-1014.meaning: The exchange could not deliver a response to the participant it was meant for, because that participant's endpoint did not take it.
fix: Keep your response and its correlation id.
Send it again once the original sender's endpoint is reachable.
If the exchange answers NHCX-1010, the request is gone. The original sender must start again.
Check that your registered endpoint is reachable and answers HTTP 202 within 30 seconds.

NHCX-1015.title: The client is not allowed to change this participant's registry details
NHCX-1015.meaning: NHCX-1015 means the participant registry refused an update because the client id behind the token did not create the participant, so send the change with the creator's credentials or through the NHCX portal or support.
fix: Find the client id that created the participant. The team that onboarded it holds those credentials.
Mint a token with those credentials and send the update again.
If the creator's credentials are gone, change the record on the NHCX portal, or ask NHCX support to change it. Give support the participant_code and the message text.

NHCX-1016.title: The call does not fit the exchange open on this correlation id
NHCX-1016.meaning: The exchange refused your call because its path is not a valid next step for the exchange open under this correlation id, so answer on the paired path.
fix: Answer each request on the on_ path paired with the path it arrived on.
Give each new request cycle its own correlation id.
Check what the exchange holds for the correlation id before you retry.

NHCX-1017.title: The recipient answered a delivery in a form the exchange does not accept
NHCX-1017.meaning: NHCX-1017 means the recipient's system answered a delivered message with a status or body the exchange does not accept, so the exchange treats the delivery as failed; the sheet prints the same text for NHCX-1015, which is a registry refusal.
fix: Answer every delivery with HTTP 202 and this body before you process it:
Copy api_call_id and correlation_id from the delivery you received.
Set entity_type to the use case of the delivery.
Leave error.code and error.message as empty strings when you accept.

NHCX-1018.title: The ABHA number is not in the XX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX form
NHCX-1018.meaning: The exchange refused the message because the beneficiary's health account number is not written as fourteen digits in hyphenated groups of two, four, four and four.
fix: Format the ABHA number as XX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX before you place it in x-hcx-ben-abha-id.
Store the 14 digits once, and format them where you build the header. Every call then uses the same form.
Send the request again with a fresh x-hcx-correlation_id. Reusing the old one returns NHCX-1006.

NHCX-401.title: The exchange does not accept your authorisation for this call
NHCX-401.meaning: The exchange refused the call because it does not accept the token or the caller behind it, so renew the session token and check your participant may make this call.
fix: Call the session endpoint for a new token and retry with it.
Send the token as bearer_auth: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN_FROM_SESSION_TOKEN>. The exchange's own endpoints read bearer_auth, not Authorization.
Generate the token with the client id used when your participant was created.
If every call returns this code, see Every call returns 401.

PAYR-1001.title: The recipient could not decrypt your request
PAYR-1001.meaning: The receiving payer could not open your sealed request, usually because it was sealed with the wrong or an outdated certificate, so fetch the current certificate and send again.
fix: Confirm the recipient is a registered participant with POST /participant/search.
Fetch the recipient's current certificate from the registry with POST /fetch/certs.
Seal the request again with that certificate. Check that every header listed above is present.
Send the request again with a fresh x-hcx-correlation_id. Reusing the old one returns NHCX-1006.

PAYR-1002.title: The payer could not encrypt its answer to you
PAYR-1002.meaning: The payer processed your request but could not seal its answer with the certificate you registered, so upload a valid certificate and the payer sends the answer.
fix: Confirm your organisation is a registered participant.
Upload a valid encryption certificate to NHCX.
Wait for the payer's answer. You do not need to resend the request.
If the answer does not arrive, contact NHCX support.

PAYR-1003.title: The payer's system could not reach the exchange and will resend, or the workflow requested is not valid
PAYR-1003.meaning: PAYR-1003 means one of two things, the payer's system could not reach the exchange and will resend or, from the national scheme's reference payer, the workflow requested is not valid, and the message text that comes with the code tells them apart.
fix: Set x-hcx-workflow_id to the workflow code for this stage.
Send the request again with a fresh x-hcx-correlation_id. Reusing the old one returns NHCX-1006.

PAYR-1004.title: Your facility is not registered with the payer for the policy, or the FHIR bundle is malformed
PAYR-1004.meaning: PAYR-1004 means one of two things, your facility is not registered with the payer for the policy or, from the national scheme's reference payer, the data bundle is malformed, and the message text that comes with the code tells them apart.
fix: Confirm with the payer that your facility is registered for this policy.
Check that the request names the beneficiary's policy.
Send the request again with a fresh x-hcx-correlation_id. Reusing the old one returns NHCX-1006.
Read the details at the end of the message and fix what they name.

PAYR-1005.title: The beneficiary is not a covered member of the policy, or the request is more than 24 hours old
PAYR-1005.meaning: PAYR-1005 means one of two things, the beneficiary is not a covered member of the policy or, from the national scheme's reference payer, the request is more than 24 hours old, and the message text that comes with the code tells them apart.
fix: Confirm membership with a coverage eligibility check.
Enrol the beneficiary for the policy with the payer, or use the policy that covers them.
Send the request again with a fresh x-hcx-correlation_id. Reusing the old one returns NHCX-1006.
Set x-hcx-timestamp to the current time when you build each request.

PAYR-1006.title: The policy does not exist, or a name in the request is not valid
PAYR-1006.meaning: PAYR-1006 means one of two things, the policy does not exist or, from the national scheme's reference payer, a name in the request is not valid, and the message text that comes with the code tells them apart.
fix: Take the policy from the beneficiary's policy lookup.
Address the request to the payer that holds that policy.
Send the request again with a fresh x-hcx-correlation_id. Reusing the old one returns NHCX-1006.
Check every name in the request, starting with the patient's name in the Patient resource.

PAYR-1007.title: The policy has expired, or the gender in the request is not valid
PAYR-1007.meaning: PAYR-1007 means one of two things, the policy has expired or, from the national scheme's reference payer, the gender in the request is not valid, and the message text that comes with the code tells them apart.
fix: Check the beneficiary's current policy with a coverage eligibility check.
Send the request against a policy that is in force.
Send the request again with a fresh x-hcx-correlation_id. Reusing the old one returns NHCX-1006.
Send the gender as a code from the value set at https://hl7.org/fhir/R4/valueset-administrative-gender.html.

PAYR-1008.title: The beneficiary's remaining cover is not enough for the request, or the FHIR bundle is not valid or cannot be parsed
PAYR-1008.meaning: PAYR-1008 means one of two things, the beneficiary's remaining cover is not enough for the request or, from the national scheme's reference payer, the data bundle is not valid or cannot be parsed; the PMJAY payer also sends it with fifteen texts the error sheet prints without a code, and the message text tells them apart.
fix: Check the remaining cover with a coverage eligibility check.
Request no more than the remaining cover.
Send the request again with a fresh x-hcx-correlation_id. Reusing the old one returns NHCX-1006.

Match the text against the table above and fix the element it names: the attachment's data, title or contentType, the HFR id, the hospital id, the case number, or the Task's code and reason code pair.

PAYR-1009.title: The requested items are not valid or not covered, or the Patient resource has no identifier
PAYR-1009.meaning: PAYR-1009 means one of two things, the requested items are not valid or not covered or, from the national scheme's reference payer, the Patient resource has no identifier, and the message text that comes with the code tells them apart.
fix: Check each item against the policy's covered items.
Remove or replace items the policy does not cover.
Send the request again with a fresh x-hcx-correlation_id. Reusing the old one returns NHCX-1006.
Add an identifier to the Patient resource. The profile is at https://www.nrces.in/ndhm/fhir/r4/StructureDefinition-Patient.html.

PAYR-1010.title: A preauthorisation was required but not obtained, or the Patient identifier has no type
PAYR-1010.meaning: PAYR-1010 means one of two things, a preauthorisation was required but not obtained or, from the national scheme's reference payer, the Patient identifier has no type, and the message text that comes with the code tells them apart.
fix: Obtain a preauthorisation before the claim or enhancement.
Carry the approved preauthorisation's reference in the later request.
Send the request again with a fresh x-hcx-correlation_id. Reusing the old one returns NHCX-1006.
Give every identifier a type, starting with the Patient identifier. The profile is at https://www.nrces.in/ndhm/fhir/r4/StructureDefinition-Patient.html.

PAYR-1011.title: The approved package does not support enhancement, or the Claim resource has no identifier
PAYR-1011.meaning: PAYR-1011 means one of two things, the approved package does not support enhancement or, from the national scheme's reference payer, the Claim resource has no identifier, and the message text that comes with the code tells them apart.
fix: Do not resend the same enhancement. The payer refuses it again.
Check whether a package allows enhancement before you send one.
Add an identifier to the Claim resource.
Send the request again with a fresh x-hcx-correlation_id. Reusing the old one returns NHCX-1006.

PAYR-1012.title: The claim amount is more than the approved preauthorisation amount, or the Claim identifier has no type
PAYR-1012.meaning: PAYR-1012 means one of two things, the claim amount is more than the approved preauthorisation amount or, from the national scheme's reference payer, the Claim identifier has no type, and the message text that comes with the code tells them apart.
fix: Compare the claimed total with the approved amount in the preauthorisation's ClaimResponse.
Reduce the claim to the approved amount, or obtain an enhancement first.
Send the request again with a fresh x-hcx-correlation_id. Reusing the old one returns NHCX-1006.
Give the Claim resource's identifier a type.

PAYR-1013.title: The procedures or packages have no prior approval, or the provider Organization resource has no identifier
PAYR-1013.meaning: PAYR-1013 means one of two things, the procedures or packages have no prior approval or, from the national scheme's reference payer, the provider Organization resource has no identifier, and the message text that comes with the code tells them apart.
fix: Claim or enhance only procedures and packages the preauthorisation approved.
Obtain approval for any other procedure first.
Send the request again with a fresh x-hcx-correlation_id. Reusing the old one returns NHCX-1006.
Add an identifier to the provider Organization resource. Send your HFR ID as that identifier, with type code NPI.

PAYR-1014.title: The date of birth is after the date of service, or the provider Organization identifier has no type
PAYR-1014.meaning: PAYR-1014 means one of two things, the date of birth is after the date of service or, from the national scheme's reference payer, the provider Organization identifier has no type, and the message text that comes with the code tells them apart.
fix: Check the Patient birthDate and every service date in the request.
Correct whichever date is wrong.
Send the request again with a fresh x-hcx-correlation_id. Reusing the old one returns NHCX-1006.
Give the provider Organization identifier a type. For the HFR ID, the type code is NPI.

PAYR-1015.title: The date of service is after the date of death, or the payer Organization resource has no identifier
PAYR-1015.meaning: PAYR-1015 means one of two things, the date of service is after the date of death or, from the national scheme's reference payer, the payer Organization resource has no identifier, and the message text that comes with the code tells them apart.
fix: Check the service dates and the date of death in the claim.
Correct whichever date is wrong.
Send the request again with a fresh x-hcx-correlation_id. Reusing the old one returns NHCX-1006.
Add an identifier to the payer Organization resource.

PAYR-1016.title: The claim duplicates one already submitted for the same services and dates, or the payer Organization identifier has no type
PAYR-1016.meaning: PAYR-1016 means one of two things, the claim duplicates one already submitted for the same services and dates or, from the national scheme's reference payer, the payer Organization identifier has no type, and the message text that comes with the code tells them apart.
fix: Check whether you already submitted a claim for these services and dates.
Do not submit it again. Follow the first claim instead.
Give the payer Organization identifier a type.
Send the request again with a fresh x-hcx-correlation_id. Reusing the old one returns NHCX-1006.

PAYR-1017.title: The amount calculations are not correct, or the Task resource has no task code
PAYR-1017.meaning: PAYR-1017 means one of two things, the amount calculations are not correct or, from the national scheme's reference payer, the Task resource has no task code, and the message text that comes with the code tells them apart.
fix: Recompute each item's net amount from its quantity and unit price.
Recompute the total from the items.
Send the request again with a fresh x-hcx-correlation_id. Reusing the old one returns NHCX-1006.
Set Task.code, for example reprocess or cancel.

PAYR-1018.title: The time limit for submission has expired, or the Task resource has no reason code
PAYR-1018.meaning: PAYR-1018 means one of two things, the time limit for submission has expired or, from the national scheme's reference payer, the Task resource has no reason code, and the message text that comes with the code tells them apart.
fix: Submit within the payer's time limit for each stage.
For a submission that is already late, contact the payer. Resending it returns the same code.
Set Task.reasonCode, for example claimrejected for a reprocess, or a cancellation reason such as patientrequest. The input, code and reason code must form a valid combination.
Send the request again with a fresh x-hcx-correlation_id. Reusing the old one returns NHCX-1006.

PAYR-1019.title: The additional information the payer asked for did not arrive in time, or a supporting info sequence is not valid
PAYR-1019.meaning: PAYR-1019 means one of two things, the additional information the payer asked for did not arrive in time or, from the national scheme's reference payer, a supporting info sequence is not valid, and the message text that comes with the code tells them apart.
fix: Answer each payer query within the time limit, with every document asked for.
For a query already past its limit, contact the payer.
Number each supportingInfo entry with a unique sequence.
Use those numbers wherever the bundle refers to a supporting info entry.

PAYR-1020.title: The payer holds no valid bank details for your facility, or a supporting info category is not valid
PAYR-1020.meaning: PAYR-1020 means one of two things, the payer holds no valid bank details for your facility or, from the national scheme's reference payer, a supporting info category is not valid, and the message text that comes with the code tells them apart.
fix: Contact the payer to register or correct your facility's bank details.
Payment for the claim can go ahead once the payer holds valid details.
Set category on the entry named in the message to a code from https://www.nrces.in/ndhm/fhir/r4/ValueSet-ndhm-supportinginfo-category.html.
Send the request again with a fresh x-hcx-correlation_id. Reusing the old one returns NHCX-1006.

PAYR-1021.title: PAYR-1021, a supporting info entry has an invalid code
PAYR-1021.meaning: The payer rejected your preauthorisation or claim because one supporting information entry carries a code that does not fit it.
fix: Find the Claim.supportingInfo entry whose sequence matches the number in the message.
Check its category and code as a pair. The payer reads these pairs:
Take codes from the NRCeS supporting info code value set, https://www.nrces.in/ndhm/fhir/r4/ValueSet-ndhm-supportinginfo-code.html.
Validate the corrected bundle before you send it.

PAYR-1023.title: PAYR-1023, a procedure has an invalid category
PAYR-1023.meaning: The payer rejected your preauthorisation or claim because a procedure in it has a missing or unaccepted category.
fix: Open each Procedure resource in the bundle.
Give it a category coding. The sample bundles use code Stratification with system http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/procedure-category.
Validate the corrected bundle before you send it.
Send the request with a new x-hcx-correlation_id and a new x-hcx-api_call_id. The failed correlation id is inactive. Reusing it returns NHCX-1006.

PAYR-1024.title: PAYR-1024, a procedure has an invalid status
PAYR-1024.meaning: The payer rejected your preauthorisation or claim because a procedure in it has a missing or unaccepted status.
fix: Open each Procedure resource in the bundle.
Set Procedure.status. The sample preauthorisation and claim bundles use preparation.
Validate the corrected bundle before you send it.
Send the request with a new x-hcx-correlation_id and a new x-hcx-api_call_id. The failed correlation id is inactive. Reusing it returns NHCX-1006.

PAYR-1025.title: PAYR-1025, a procedure has an invalid sequence
PAYR-1025.meaning: The payer rejected your preauthorisation or claim because it cannot read a valid sequence number for one of its procedures.
fix: Number the Claim.procedure entries from 1 in sequence, one number per procedure.
Make each item's procedureSequence name one of those numbers. The sample preauthorisation bundle sets procedureSequence to 1 on its item.
Validate the corrected bundle before you send it.
Send the request with a new x-hcx-correlation_id and a new x-hcx-api_call_id. The failed correlation id is inactive. Reusing it returns NHCX-1006.

PAYR-1026.title: PAYR-1026, the claim references a procedure that is not in the bundle
PAYR-1026.meaning: The payer rejected your preauthorisation or claim because the claim points at a procedure record that the bundle does not contain.
fix: List the procedureReference values in Claim.procedure.
For each one, add the Procedure resource to the bundle, or correct the reference.
Make the reference resolve to the Procedure entry's fullUrl. The sample bundles pair procedureReference procedure/1 with a Procedure entry whose fullUrl ends in claim/procedure/1.
Validate the corrected bundle before you send it.

PAYR-1027.title: PAYR-1027, a claim item has an invalid id
PAYR-1027.meaning: The payer rejected your preauthorisation or claim because one of the billed items has a missing or unreadable id.
fix: Open each entry in Claim.item.
Give it an id. The sample preauthorisation bundle gives its first item the id Item/1.
Validate the corrected bundle before you send it.
Send the request with a new x-hcx-correlation_id and a new x-hcx-api_call_id. The failed correlation id is inactive. Reusing it returns NHCX-1006.

PAYR-1028.title: PAYR-1028, a claim item has an invalid sequence
PAYR-1028.meaning: The payer rejected your preauthorisation or claim because one of the billed items has a missing or unreadable sequence number.
fix: Number the Claim.item entries from 1 in sequence, one number per item.
Keep the item's careTeamSequence, diagnosisSequence and procedureSequence pointing at real entries. The sample preauthorisation bundle gives its only item sequence 1.
Validate the corrected bundle before you send it.
Send the request with a new x-hcx-correlation_id and a new x-hcx-api_call_id. The failed correlation id is inactive. Reusing it returns NHCX-1006.

PAYR-1029.title: PAYR-1029, the bundle id is invalid
PAYR-1029.meaning: The payer rejected your request because the outer bundle that carries it has a missing or unreadable id.
fix: Set Bundle.id on the outer bundle.
Use a plain identifier. The sample bundles use ids such as PreAuth and CLAIM.
Validate the corrected bundle before you send it.
Send the request with a new x-hcx-correlation_id and a new x-hcx-api_call_id. The failed correlation id is inactive. Reusing it returns NHCX-1006.

PAYR-1030.title: PAYR-1030, a questionnaire id in the bundle is invalid
PAYR-1030.meaning: The payer rejected your preauthorisation or claim because the id of a questionnaire answer in it is not valid.
fix: Fetch the insurance plan for the policy.
Take questionnaire ids from the plan. Do not build them yourself.
Give each QuestionnaireResponse a valid id.
Reference it from Claim.supportingInfo with category INF and code ODN. For a questionnaire tied to a procedure code, use category STG.

PAYR-1031.title: PAYR-1031, a bundle entry has an invalid URL
PAYR-1031.meaning: The payer rejected your request because one of the entries in its bundle has a missing or unreadable address.
fix: Give every entry a fullUrl. The sample bundles use either an https:// URL or a urn:uuid: value.
Make every reference in the bundle match the fullUrl of the entry it points at.
Validate the corrected bundle before you send it.
Send the request with a new x-hcx-correlation_id and a new x-hcx-api_call_id. The failed correlation id is inactive. Reusing it returns NHCX-1006.

PAYR-1032.title: PAYR-1032, the eligibility check has an invalid purpose
PAYR-1032.meaning: The payer rejected your eligibility check because it does not say, in a form the payer accepts, what you want to know.
fix: Set CoverageEligibilityRequest.purpose to auth-requirements, benefits or validation.
Choose by what you need to learn.
Validate the corrected bundle before you send it.
Send the request with a new x-hcx-correlation_id and a new x-hcx-api_call_id. The failed correlation id is inactive. Reusing it returns NHCX-1006.

PAYR-1033.title: PAYR-1033, the eligibility check has no items for its purpose
PAYR-1033.meaning: The payer rejected your eligibility check because it asks about treatment but lists no treatment items.
fix: Add at least one item to the CoverageEligibilityRequest.
Name the package you are asking about in that item. The sample checks name the package this way.
Validate the corrected bundle before you send it.
Send the request with a new x-hcx-correlation_id and a new x-hcx-api_call_id. The failed correlation id is inactive. Reusing it returns NHCX-1006.

PAYR-1034.title: PAYR-1034, a procedure code is invalid
PAYR-1034.meaning: The payer rejected your preauthorisation or claim because a procedure code in it is not one the payer accepts.
fix: Fetch the insurance plan for the policy.
Take procedure codes from the plan. The procedure code is the code of each benefit's type, under the plan's specific cost.
Use the same code in Procedure.code and in the item's productOrService, as the sample bundles do.
Validate the corrected bundle before you send it.

PAYR-1035.title: PAYR-1035, the policy code is invalid
PAYR-1035.meaning: The payer rejected your request because the insurance policy it names is not one the payer recognises.
fix: Check the policy details in the Coverage resource of your bundle.
For an insurance plan request, check the PolicyNumber input of the Task.
Correct the code, then resend.
Validate the corrected bundle before you send it.

PAYR-1036.title: PAYR-1036, a supporting info entry lacks a valid attachment
PAYR-1036.meaning: The payer rejected your preauthorisation or claim because a supporting document entry does not carry a usable document.
fix: Find the Claim.supportingInfo entry whose sequence matches the number in the message.
Put the document in valueAttachment. Encode it as Base64 in data, give it a non-empty title, and set contentType.

PAYR-1093.title: An encounter linked from a composition has no subject

fix: Find the Encounter that each Composition's encounter points at.
Set the Encounter's subject.reference to the fullUrl of the Patient entry. Use the Patient that the Composition's subject points at.
Check the Encounter against the NRCES Encounter profile.
Validate the corrected bundle in the NRCES validator before you send it.

PAYR-1094.title: An encounter's subject has the wrong resource type
PAYR-1094.meaning: The payer rejected your preauthorisation or claim because an encounter in the bundle names a subject that is not a patient.
fix: Find each Encounter that a Composition's encounter or an Observation points at.
Set its subject.reference to the fullUrl of the Patient entry in the same bundle. Use the Patient that the Composition's subject points at.
Check the Encounter against the NRCES Encounter profile.
Validate the corrected bundle in the NRCES validator before you send it.

PAYR-1095.title: The claim carries no valid discharge information
PAYR-1095.meaning: The payer rejected your claim because it carries no valid information about how the patient was discharged.
fix: Add a Claim.supportingInfo entry with category DIS and one of the codes LAMA, DAMA, DTH or DTM. The value sets are supporting info category and supporting info code.
Send its value as a string naming the discharge stage: After Surgery, Before Surgery or During Surgery. PAYR-1514 covers a wrong value type.
Give the entry a sequence no other supporting info entry uses.
Validate the corrected bundle in the NRCES validator before you send it.

PAYR-1096.title: A death discharge carries no valid death date
PAYR-1096.meaning: The payer rejected your claim because the patient's discharge type is death and the claim carries no valid date of death.
fix: Add a Claim.supportingInfo entry with category ONS and code DTM, carrying the date of death. The value sets are supporting info category and supporting info code.
Send the date as a timing (a date or a period) or as a string value. PAYR-1503 covers a wrong value type.
Give the entry a sequence no other supporting info entry uses.
Validate the corrected bundle in the NRCES validator before you send it.

PAYR-1097.title: The request arrived with no encrypted payload
PAYR-1097.meaning: The payer rejected your request because it found no encrypted content inside it.
fix: Encrypt the FHIR bundle with the payer's public certificate.
Put the resulting compact string in payload:
Check that the ciphertext part of the compact string is not empty before you send it.
Send it as a new request with a new x-hcx-correlation_id. After a failure the old correlation id is inactive, and reusing it returns NHCX-1006.

PAYR-1098.title: The registration date has the wrong value type
PAYR-1098.meaning: The payer rejected your preauthorisation or claim because the patient's registration date is sent in a form it does not accept.
fix: Find the Claim.supportingInfo entry whose sequence matches the message.
Send the registration date as a timing (a date or a period) or as valueString, in NRCES date format.
Validate the corrected bundle in the NRCES validator before you send it.
Send it as a new request with a new x-hcx-correlation_id. After a failure the old correlation id is inactive, and reusing it returns NHCX-1006.

PAYR-1099.title: The discharge date has the wrong value type
PAYR-1099.meaning: The payer rejected your claim because the patient's discharge date is sent in a form it does not accept.
fix: Find the Claim.supportingInfo entry whose sequence matches the message.
Send the discharge date with category ONS and code DSDE, as a timing (a date or a period) or as valueString, in NRCES date format.
Validate the corrected bundle in the NRCES validator before you send it.
Send it as a new request with a new x-hcx-correlation_id. After a failure the old correlation id is inactive, and reusing it returns NHCX-1006.

PAYR-1101.title: The eligibility purpose is not valid
PAYR-1101.meaning: The payer returned no result because the purpose of your eligibility check is not one it accepts.
fix: Set CoverageEligibilityRequest.purpose to discovery, validation, benefits or auth-requirements.
For auth-requirements, include the procedures you are asking about in item. PAYR-1033 covers a check with no items.
When you do not have the policy code, send discovery first. Then send validation with the policy_code you receive.
Send the corrected check as a new request with a new x-hcx-correlation_id. After a failure the old correlation id is inactive, and reusing it returns NHCX-1006.

PAYR-1102.title: The id you searched with is not valid
PAYR-1102.meaning: The payer could not find a beneficiary because the id your request searched with is not valid.
fix: Correct the beneficiary identifiers on the Patient resource. An eligibility check must carry the PMJAY member id, the ABHA number, or both.
Send the corrected check as a new request with a new x-hcx-correlation_id. After a failure the old correlation id is inactive, and reusing it returns NHCX-1006.
If the same code comes back after these steps, contact the NHCX support team. Give them the correlation id of the failed request.

PAYR-1103.title: The care plan id is not valid
PAYR-1103.meaning: The payer rejected your request because the care plan id in it is not valid.
fix: Correct the care plan id in your request.
Send the check again with a valid care plan id.
Send the corrected check as a new request with a new x-hcx-correlation_id. After a failure the old correlation id is inactive, and reusing it returns NHCX-1006.
If the same code comes back after these steps, contact the NHCX support team. Give them the correlation id of the failed request.

PAYR-1104.title: More than one beneficiary record matches
PAYR-1104.meaning: The payer stopped processing your request because the beneficiary details you sent match more than one of its records.
fix: Send identifiers that point at one person. Put both the PMJAY member id and the ABHA number on the Patient resource when you have them.
If the request already carries both, contact the support team. The payer must resolve the duplicate record.
Send the corrected check as a new request with a new x-hcx-correlation_id. After a failure the old correlation id is inactive, and reusing it returns NHCX-1006.

PAYR-1105.title: The payer has no configuration for your hospital
PAYR-1105.meaning: The payer stopped processing your check because it holds no configuration for your hospital.
fix: Check the provider Organization in your bundle. It must carry your HFR id as an identifier with type code NPI.
The HFR id must match the registry id recorded in NHCX for your participant code.
Contact the support team to have the payer set up your hospital's configuration.
Once the payer confirms the setup, send the check as a new request with a new x-hcx-correlation_id. After a failure the old correlation id is inactive, and reusing it returns NHCX-1006.

PAYR-1106.title: The payer has no details for a requested procedure
PAYR-1106.meaning: The payer found no details for a procedure you asked about in your eligibility check.
fix: Check each item[*].productOrService.coding.code in the request.
Use the procedure code from the payer's insurance plan: the code of the type of the benefit component of the specific cost of the plan.
Fetch the insurance plan for the policy when you do not have it.
Send the corrected check as a new request with a new x-hcx-correlation_id. After a failure the old correlation id is inactive, and reusing it returns NHCX-1006.

PAYR-1107.title: The check carries no billable item
PAYR-1107.meaning: The payer rejected your eligibility check because it carries no item it can bill against.
fix: Add at least one item to the CoverageEligibilityRequest.
Give each item a speciality in category.coding.code, a package or procedure code in productOrService.coding.code, and a quantity.value.
Take the codes from the payer's insurance plan for the policy.
Send the corrected check as a new request with a new x-hcx-correlation_id. After a failure the old correlation id is inactive, and reusing it returns NHCX-1006.

PAYR-1108.title: The payer has no details for the requested stratification
PAYR-1108.meaning: The payer found no details for the stratification you asked about in your eligibility check.
fix: Check each item[*].modifier.coding.code in the request.
Use a stratification code the payer holds for that package in its insurance plan.
Send the corrected check as a new request with a new x-hcx-correlation_id. After a failure the old correlation id is inactive, and reusing it returns NHCX-1006.
If the same code comes back after these steps, contact the NHCX support team. Give them the correlation id of the failed request.

PAYR-1109.title: The payer has no details for a requested investigation
PAYR-1109.meaning: The payer found no details for an investigation you asked about in your eligibility check.
fix: Check the investigation codes in item[*].productOrService.coding.code.
Use an investigation code the payer holds in its insurance plan for the policy.
Send the corrected check as a new request with a new x-hcx-correlation_id. After a failure the old correlation id is inactive, and reusing it returns NHCX-1006.
If the same code comes back after these steps, contact the NHCX support team. Give them the correlation id of the failed request.

PAYR-1110.title: The payer has no details for a requested implant
PAYR-1110.meaning: The payer found no details for an implant you asked about in your eligibility check.
fix: Check the implant codes in item[*].productOrService.coding.code.
Use an implant code the payer holds in its insurance plan for the policy.
Send the corrected check as a new request with a new x-hcx-correlation_id. After a failure the old correlation id is inactive, and reusing it returns NHCX-1006.
If the same code comes back after these steps, contact the NHCX support team. Give them the correlation id of the failed request.

PAYR-1111.title: A payer rule rejected the request
PAYR-1111.meaning: A business rule at the payer rejected your eligibility check, and the message does not name the rule.
fix: Contact the support team with the correlation id of the failed check. The payer can name the rule that failed.
Correct the request once you know the rule.
Send the corrected check as a new request with a new x-hcx-correlation_id. After a failure the old correlation id is inactive, and reusing it returns NHCX-1006.

PAYR-1112.title: The payer id is not valid
PAYR-1112.meaning: The payer rejected your eligibility check because the payer id in it is not valid.
fix: Check x-hcx-recipient_code in the protected header and the insurer Organization in the bundle.
Use the processingID from the get policies response as the recipient code, not the PayerID.
Send the corrected check as a new request with a new x-hcx-correlation_id. After a failure the old correlation id is inactive, and reusing it returns NHCX-1006.
If the same code comes back after these steps, contact the NHCX support team. Give them the correlation id of the failed request.

PAYR-1113.title: An item code is not valid
PAYR-1113.meaning: The payer rejected your eligibility check because an item code in it is not valid.
fix: Find the item whose productOrService.coding.code matches the message.
Replace it with a package or procedure code from the payer's insurance plan for the policy.
Send the corrected check as a new request with a new x-hcx-correlation_id. After a failure the old correlation id is inactive, and reusing it returns NHCX-1006.
If the same code comes back after these steps, contact the NHCX support team. Give them the correlation id of the failed request.

PAYR-1114.title: An item's speciality code is not valid
PAYR-1114.meaning: The payer rejected your eligibility check because the speciality code on one item is not valid.
fix: Find the item named in the message and its category.coding.code.
Replace it with the speciality code from the payer's insurance plan: the code of the category of the specific cost of the plan.
Send the corrected check as a new request with a new x-hcx-correlation_id. After a failure the old correlation id is inactive, and reusing it returns NHCX-1006.
If the same code comes back after these steps, contact the NHCX support team. Give them the correlation id of the failed request.

PAYR-1115.title: An item's quantity is not valid
PAYR-1115.meaning: The payer rejected your eligibility check because the quantity on one item is not valid.
fix: Find the item named in the message.
Correct its quantity.value to the number of units you are asking about.
Send the corrected check as a new request with a new x-hcx-correlation_id. After a failure the old correlation id is inactive, and reusing it returns NHCX-1006.
If the same code comes back after these steps, contact the NHCX support team. Give them the correlation id of the failed request.

PAYR-1116.title: Your hospital is not authorised under the policy
PAYR-1116.meaning: The payer stopped processing your check because your hospital is not authorised to raise cases under the policy.
fix: Contact the support team to get your hospital authorised under the policy named in the message.
Raise no cases under that policy until the authorisation is in place.
Once the authorisation is in place, send the check as a new request with a new x-hcx-correlation_id. After a failure the old correlation id is inactive, and reusing it returns NHCX-1006.

PAYR-1117.title: The payer has no details for the policy
PAYR-1117.meaning: The payer stopped processing your check because it holds no details for the policy you named.
fix: Check the policy code in the Coverage resource's identifier.value.
When you do not have the policy code, send a check with purpose discovery to fetch the active policy_code. Then send validation with it.
Send the corrected check as a new request with a new x-hcx-correlation_id. After a failure the old correlation id is inactive, and reusing it returns NHCX-1006.
If the same code comes back after these steps, contact the NHCX support team. Give them the correlation id of the failed request.

PAYR-1118.title: The payer has no details for the requested items
PAYR-1118.meaning: The payer stopped processing your eligibility check because it holds no details for the items you asked about.
fix: Check every item's productOrService.coding.code, category.coding.code and modifier.coding.code.
Take each code from the payer's insurance plan for the policy.
Send the corrected check as a new request with a new x-hcx-correlation_id. After a failure the old correlation id is inactive, and reusing it returns NHCX-1006.
If the same code comes back after these steps, contact the NHCX support team. Give them the correlation id of the failed request.

PAYR-1119.title: The payer received no details for the payer id from the exchange
PAYR-1119.meaning: The payer stopped processing your check because the exchange returned no details for the payer id you sent.
fix: Look up the payer in the participant registry, and use the participant code it returns.
Use the processingID from the get policies response as the recipient code, not the PayerID.
Send the corrected check as a new request with a new x-hcx-correlation_id. After a failure the old correlation id is inactive, and reusing it returns NHCX-1006.
If the same code comes back after these steps, contact the NHCX support team. Give them the correlation id of the failed request.

PAYR-1120.title: The reference id has been used before
PAYR-1120.meaning: The payer rejected your eligibility check because its reference id repeats one it has already seen.
fix: Give every request its own reference id.
Send the check again with a reference id you have not used before.
Send the corrected check as a new request with a new x-hcx-correlation_id. After a failure the old correlation id is inactive, and reusing it returns NHCX-1006.
If the same code comes back after these steps, contact the NHCX support team. Give them the correlation id of the failed request.

PAYR-1121.title: The policy is not found for this beneficiary
PAYR-1121.meaning: The payer stopped processing your check because it holds no record of the named policy for this beneficiary.
fix: Fetch the beneficiary's linked policies with the get policies call, and use a policy code from the result.
When no policy is linked, send a check with purpose discovery to fetch the active policy_code.
Send the corrected check as a new request with a new x-hcx-correlation_id. After a failure the old correlation id is inactive, and reusing it returns NHCX-1006.
If the same code comes back after these steps, contact the NHCX support team. Give them the correlation id of the failed request.

PAYR-1122.title: The beneficiary has no policy with the payer
PAYR-1122.meaning: The payer stopped processing your check because it holds no policy for the beneficiary.
fix: Check the beneficiary identifiers on the Patient resource: the PMJAY member id, the ABHA number, or both.
Confirm the beneficiary holds a policy with this payer. Fetch linked policies with the get policies call.
Send the corrected check as a new request with a new x-hcx-correlation_id. After a failure the old correlation id is inactive, and reusing it returns NHCX-1006.
If the same code comes back after these steps, contact the NHCX support team. Give them the correlation id of the failed request.

PAYR-1123.title: The beneficiary is not covered by this payer
PAYR-1123.meaning: The payer stopped processing your check because the beneficiary is not a covered member of any of its policies.
fix: Confirm which payer covers the beneficiary. Fetch the beneficiary's policies with the get policies call.
Send the check to the processingID from that response as the recipient code, not the PayerID.
If no policy of this payer covers the beneficiary, the beneficiary must be enrolled for an applicable policy first.
Send the corrected check as a new request with a new x-hcx-correlation_id. After a failure the old correlation id is inactive, and reusing it returns NHCX-1006.

PAYR-1201.title: Claimed amount is zero or above the wallet balance
PAYR-1201.meaning: The payer refused the request because the amount claimed was zero, or larger than the balance left in the beneficiary's scheme wallet.
fix: Check the balance before you submit. Run a coverage eligibility check with purpose validation. It returns the used amount, the available balance and the wallet liability.
Set Claim.total above 0 and no higher than the available balance.
Resend the request.

PAYR-1202.title: Speciality code is not in the insurance plan
PAYR-1202.meaning: The payer refused the request because an item names a speciality code that the hospital's insurance plan does not carry.
fix: Fetch the current insurance plan for your hospital and the beneficiary's policy.
Find the package under plan.specificCost. Copy that entry's category code into Claim.item.category for the named item.
Resend the request.

PAYR-1203.title: Speciality description does not match the insurance plan
PAYR-1203.meaning: The payer refused the request because a speciality description differs from the one in the hospital's insurance plan.
fix: Fetch the current insurance plan for your hospital and the beneficiary's policy.
Copy the display of the matching category exactly as the plan carries it.
Take the code and the description from the same plan entry.
Resend the request.

PAYR-1204.title: Procedure code is not in the insurance plan
PAYR-1204.meaning: The payer refused the request because a procedure code is not one the hospital's insurance plan offers.
fix: Fetch the current insurance plan for your hospital and the beneficiary's policy.
Pick the package from the plan. Copy the benefit type code into Claim.item.productOrService.
Do not type package codes by hand.
Resend the request.

PAYR-1205.title: Procedure description does not match the insurance plan
PAYR-1205.meaning: The payer refused the request because a procedure description differs from the one in the hospital's insurance plan.
fix: Fetch the current insurance plan for your hospital and the beneficiary's policy.
Copy the benefit type display exactly as the plan carries it.
Take the code and the description from the same plan entry.
Resend the request.

PAYR-1206.title: Procedure type is not accepted
PAYR-1206.meaning: The payer refused the request because the type sent for a procedure is not one it accepts.
fix: Set every procedure component to the value the insurance plan response gives for the package. Do not derive these values by hand.
Correct the type on the named Claim.procedure entry.
Resend the request.

PAYR-1207.title: Procedure factor is not accepted
PAYR-1207.meaning: The payer refused the request because the factor sent for a procedure is not one it accepts.
fix: Set every procedure component to the value the insurance plan response gives for the package.
Correct the factor for the named procedure.
Resend the request.

PAYR-1208.title: Item quantity is not accepted
PAYR-1208.meaning: The payer refused the request because the quantity sent for an item failed its check.
fix: Correct Claim.item.quantity.value for the named item.
Check it against the package in the insurance plan.
Resend the request.

PAYR-1209.title: Item net amount is zero or less
PAYR-1209.meaning: The payer refused the request because an item's net amount was not greater than zero.
fix: Give every item a net amount above 0.
Take package prices from the insurance plan. Cost values there are in rupees, with unit INR.
Resend the request.

PAYR-1210.title: Procedure status is not accepted
PAYR-1210.meaning: The payer refused the request because the status sent for a procedure is not one it accepts.
fix: Use preparation in Procedure.status for a procedure that has not happened yet.
Check that every Claim.procedure reference points at a Procedure in the bundle.
Resend the request.

PAYR-1211.title: Beneficiary and care plan match no rule at this hospital
PAYR-1211.meaning: The payer refused the request because the beneficiary and the care plan met none of its criteria for treatment at your hospital.
fix: Run a coverage eligibility check with purpose auth-requirements for the same beneficiary and procedures. It tells you whether the treatment is covered for this member at your hospital.
Correct the beneficiary or care plan details to match, or choose a package the check covers.
Resend the request.

PAYR-1212.title: Enhancement has no approved preauthorisation
PAYR-1212.meaning: The payer refused an enhancement because it holds no approved preauthorisation for that case.
fix: Check the case number. It must be the one your approved preauthorisation carries in Claim.identifier.
If the case has no approval, send a new preauthorisation with workflow 12, as the message instructs.
Send the enhancement only after approval arrives on /v1/preauth/on_submit with workflow 21.

PAYR-1213.title: Enhancement sent while the case is still in progress
PAYR-1213.meaning: The payer refused an enhancement because it is still deciding an earlier request on the same case.
fix: Wait for the payer's decision on the earlier request. It arrives on /v1/preauth/on_submit.
Send the enhancement again after that decision arrives.

PAYR-1214.title: Resubmission has no approved preauthorisation
PAYR-1214.meaning: The payer refused a resubmission because it holds no approved preauthorisation for that case.
fix: Check that the case number matches Claim.identifier on the original preauthorisation.
If no approved preauthorisation exists, send a new preauthorisation with workflow 12, as the message instructs.

PAYR-1215.title: Resubmission sent while the case is still in progress
PAYR-1215.meaning: The payer refused a resubmission because it is still deciding an earlier request on the same case.
fix: Wait for the payer's decision on the earlier request. It arrives on /v1/preauth/on_submit.
Send the resubmission again after that decision arrives.

PAYR-1216.title: New preauthorisation sent for a case already in progress
PAYR-1216.meaning: The payer refused a new preauthorisation because a request on the same case is still in progress.
fix: Do not open a second preauthorisation on a case that is in progress.
Wait for the decision on the first request. It arrives on /v1/preauth/on_submit.
If the new request is for a different admission, give it its own case number in Claim.identifier.

PAYR-1217.title: New preauthorisation sent for a case already approved
PAYR-1217.meaning: The payer refused a new preauthorisation because the case already has an approved one.
fix: To add treatment to the approved case, send an enhancement with workflow 13.
To resubmit the case, send workflow 121.
If the request is for a different admission, give it its own case number in Claim.identifier.

PAYR-1218.title: Query response sent for a case that was not queried
PAYR-1218.meaning: The payer refused a query response because it holds no queried preauthorisation for that case.
fix: Send a query response only after the payer queries the case. A query arrives on /v1/preauth/on_submit with workflow 24 and adjudication reason queried.
Check that the case number matches the queried case.
If the case was not queried, wait for the payer's decision instead.

PAYR-1219.title: Case is not in the queried state
PAYR-1219.meaning: The payer refused a query response because the case it names has not been queried.
fix: Send a query response only after the payer queries the case. A query arrives on /v1/preauth/on_submit with workflow 24 and adjudication reason queried.
Check that the case number matches the queried case.
If the case was not queried, wait for the payer's decision instead.

PAYR-1220.title: Investigation description does not match its code
PAYR-1220.meaning: The payer refused the request because an investigation's description does not match the payer's description for its code.
fix: Take investigation codes and descriptions from the coverage eligibility auth-requirements response. It lists the documents a preauthorisation needs.
Copy the display exactly as the payer published it.
Resend the request.

PAYR-1221.title: Investigation code is not valid
PAYR-1221.meaning: The payer refused the request because an investigation code is not one it recognises.
fix: Take investigation codes and descriptions from the coverage eligibility auth-requirements response. It lists the documents a preauthorisation needs.
Copy the code exactly as the payer published it.
Resend the request.

PAYR-1222.title: Investigation status is not accepted
PAYR-1222.meaning: The payer refused the request because the status sent for an investigation is not one it accepts.
fix: Correct the status on the named investigation.
Resend the request.
If the value matches your clinical record, contact the support team with the case number.

PAYR-1223.title: Investigation attachment is not valid
PAYR-1223.meaning: The payer refused the request because a document attached to an investigation failed its checks.
fix: Re-encode the file as Base64. Check its name and content type against the rules above.
Keep each file within 2 MB. Merge several documents into one file when an item needs them.
Resend the request.

PAYR-1224.title: Implant description does not match its code
PAYR-1224.meaning: The payer refused the request because an implant's description does not match the payer's description for its code.
fix: Fetch the current insurance plan for your hospital and the beneficiary's policy.
Take the implant code and its description from the same Implant cost line.
Resend the request.

PAYR-1225.title: Implant code is not valid
PAYR-1225.meaning: The payer refused the request because an implant code is not one it recognises.
fix: Fetch the current insurance plan for your hospital and the beneficiary's policy.
Use only implant codes from the plan's Implant cost lines for the package.
Resend the request.

PAYR-1226.title: Implant status is not accepted
PAYR-1226.meaning: The payer refused the request because the status sent for an implant is not one it accepts.
fix: Correct the status on the named implant.
Resend the request.
If the value matches your clinical record, contact the support team with the case number.

PAYR-1227.title: Implant attachment is not valid
PAYR-1227.meaning: The payer refused the request because a document attached to an implant failed its checks.
fix: Re-encode the file as Base64. Check its name and content type against the rules above.
Keep each file within 2 MB. Merge several documents into one file when an item needs them.
Resend the request.

PAYR-1228.title: Implant quantity is not accepted
PAYR-1228.meaning: The payer refused the request because the quantity sent for an implant failed its check.
fix: Correct the quantity for the named implant.
Check it against the implant's cost line in the insurance plan.
Resend the request.

PAYR-1229.title: Implant net amount is not accepted
PAYR-1229.meaning: The payer refused the request because the net amount sent for an implant failed its check.
fix: Fetch the current insurance plan for your hospital and the beneficiary's policy.
Work the implant's net amount from the price on its Implant cost line. Cost values are in rupees, with unit INR.
Resend the request.

PAYR-1230.title: Implant unit price is not accepted
PAYR-1230.meaning: The payer refused the request because the unit price sent for an implant failed its check.
fix: Fetch the current insurance plan for your hospital and the beneficiary's policy.
Use the price on the implant's Implant cost line. Cost values are in rupees, with unit INR.
Resend the request.

PAYR-1231.title: Claim already raised for this case
PAYR-1231.meaning: The payer refused a preauthorisation request because the final claim for the case has already been raised.
fix: Do not send further preauthorisation requests for this case number.
Continue the case on the claim.

PAYR-1232.title: Investigations missing for a private hospital
PAYR-1232.meaning: The payer refused the request because a private hospital sent no investigation details for the case.
fix: Run a coverage eligibility check with purpose auth-requirements. Its response lists the documents the preauthorisation needs.
Attach each investigation as a supportingInfo entry with category INV, Document Type - Investigation.
Resend the request.

PAYR-1233.title: Wallet short and patient liability not allowed
PAYR-1233.meaning: The payer refused the request because the beneficiary's wallet cannot cover it and your hospital may not charge the shortfall to the patient.
fix: Run a coverage eligibility check with purpose validation. It returns the used amount, the available balance and the wallet liability.
Reduce the request so it fits within the available balance.
Resend the request.

PAYR-1234.title: No preauthorisation found for the case number
PAYR-1234.meaning: The payer refused the request because it holds no preauthorisation for the case number sent.
fix: Check the case number against the one on the original preauthorisation.
If no preauthorisation exists, send a new one with workflow 12.

PAYR-1235.title: Wallet balance is insufficient
PAYR-1235.meaning: The payer refused the request because the beneficiary's wallet balance cannot cover it.
fix: Run a coverage eligibility check with purpose validation. It returns the used amount, the available balance and the wallet liability.
Reduce the request so it fits within the available balance.
Resend the request.

PAYR-1236.title: Claim type is not in-patient or out-patient
PAYR-1236.meaning: The payer refused the request because the claim type was missing or not an accepted in-patient or out-patient value.
fix: Set Claim.type with the system and code above for an in-patient case.
Resend the request.

PAYR-1237.title: Beneficiary has an active preauthorisation at another hospital
PAYR-1237.meaning: The payer refused the request because the beneficiary already has an active preauthorisation at another hospital.
fix: Ask the hospital named in the message to cancel its active preauthorisation, or to raise its claim.
Resend your request once that hospital confirms.

PAYR-1238.title: Beneficiary has an active preauthorisation at your hospital
PAYR-1238.meaning: The payer refused the request because the beneficiary already has an active preauthorisation at your hospital.
fix: Find the active preauthorisation by the reference number in the message.
Cancel it, or raise its claim.
Resend your request.

PAYR-1239.title: Hospital configuration not found
PAYR-1239.meaning: The payer refused the request because it has no configuration set up for your hospital.
fix: Contact the support team, as the message instructs.
Resend the request once the support team confirms your configuration.

PAYR-1240.title: Requested procedures not found
PAYR-1240.meaning: The payer refused the request because it holds no details for the procedures requested.
fix: Fetch the current insurance plan for your hospital and the beneficiary's policy.
Use only package codes from the current plan in Claim.item.productOrService.
Resend the request.

PAYR-1241.title: Registration date is not valid
PAYR-1241.meaning: The payer refused the request because the patient's registration date was missing or not valid.
fix: Send the registration date in a supportingInfo entry with category OTH and code EDT.
Send the value as timing, a date or a period, or as a string.
Use the NRCeS date-time format, for example 2026-03-10T21:21:17+05:30.
Resend the request.

PAYR-1242.title: Registration date format is not valid
PAYR-1242.meaning: The payer refused the request because the patient's registration date was not in an accepted format.
fix: Write the registration date in the NRCeS date-time format, for example 2026-03-10T21:21:17+05:30.
Send it as timing, a date or a period, or as a string, in the entry with category OTH and code EDT.
Resend the request.

PAYR-1243.title: Admission date is not valid
PAYR-1243.meaning: The payer refused the request because the admission date was missing or not valid.
fix: Send the admission date in a supportingInfo entry with code ADDD.
Send the value as timing, a date or a period, or as a string.
Use the NRCeS date-time format, for example 2026-03-10T21:21:17+05:30.
Resend the request.

PAYR-1244.title: Admission date format is not valid
PAYR-1244.meaning: The payer refused the request because the admission date was not in an accepted format.
fix: Write the admission date in the NRCeS date-time format, for example 2026-03-10T21:21:17+05:30.
Send it as timing, a date or a period, or as a string, in the entry with code ADDD.
Resend the request.

PAYR-1245.title: A scheme rule failed
PAYR-1245.meaning: The payer refused the request because it broke one of the scheme's business rules.
fix: Read the message text you received. Correct the request against the rule it names.
If the message reads only Rule failure., contact the support team with the case number.
Resend the request.

PAYR-1246.title: Payer id is not valid
PAYR-1246.meaning: The payer refused the request because the payer identifier in it was not valid.
fix: Set x-hcx-recipient_code to the payer's participant code.
Give the payer Organization its identifier, and point Claim.insurer at that Organization.
Resend the request.

PAYR-1247.title: Payer details not received from the exchange
PAYR-1247.meaning: The payer refused the request because it did not receive the payer details for the payer identifier sent.
fix: Check the payer id as described for PAYR-1246.
Resend the request.
If it repeats with a correct payer id, contact the support team.

PAYR-1248.title: Item code is not valid
PAYR-1248.meaning: The payer refused the request because the code on an item is not valid.
fix: Fetch the current insurance plan for your hospital and the beneficiary's policy.
Copy the package code from the plan into Claim.item.productOrService for the named item.
Resend the request.

PAYR-1249.title: Item sequence is not valid
PAYR-1249.meaning: The payer refused the request because an item's sequence number is not valid.
fix: Give every item a unique whole-number sequence, starting at 1.
Check that each cross-reference points at a sequence that exists in the Claim.
Resend the request.

PAYR-1250.title: Policy is not listed
PAYR-1250.meaning: The payer refused the request because the policy code sent is not one it lists.
fix: Use the policy code the beneficiary holds with this payer.
If you do not have it, run a coverage eligibility check with purpose discovery. It finds the active policy code.
Resend the request.

PAYR-1251.title: No billable treatment plan
PAYR-1251.meaning: The payer refused the request because it carried no billable treatment plan for the case.
fix: Add at least one item with a package code from the insurance plan, a quantity, a unit price and a net amount above 0.
Resend the request.

PAYR-1252.title: Case is not in a state that can be cancelled
PAYR-1252.meaning: The payer refused a cancellation because the case is not currently submitted or approved.
fix: Do not resend the cancellation. You cannot cancel this case.
Read the current status in the message. Continue the case from that state.

PAYR-1253.title: Case is already cancelled
PAYR-1253.meaning: The payer refused a cancellation because the case is already cancelled.
fix: Do not resend the cancellation.
Mark the case cancelled in your system.
For further treatment, raise a new preauthorisation with a new case number. A cancelled case number accepts no preauthorisation.

PAYR-1254.title: Treatment guideline questionnaire response missing
PAYR-1254.meaning: The payer refused the request because a procedure needs a completed treatment guideline checklist and none was sent.
fix: Take the STG questionnaire from the insurance plan, or from the coverage eligibility auth-requirements response.
Fill a QuestionnaireResponse. Put the questionnaire URL from the insurance plan in QuestionnaireResponse.questionnaire.
Add a supportingInfo entry to the Claim with category STG. Its value is a reference to that QuestionnaireResponse.
Include the QuestionnaireResponse resource in the bundle at that reference.

PAYR-1255.title: Case number already cancelled
PAYR-1255.meaning: The payer refused a preauthorisation because its case number belongs to a cancelled case.
fix: Raise a new preauthorisation with a new case number in Claim.identifier.
Send it with workflow 12.

PAYR-1256.title: No biometric authentication and no consent questionnaire
PAYR-1256.meaning: The payer refused a new preauthorisation because it carried neither the patient's biometric authentication nor the signed consent questionnaire.
fix: Send biometric authentication. Authenticate the patient by fingerprint, iris or face. Pass the user token from the verification as a header on the preauthorisation. The token is valid for 30 minutes.

Or send the Authentication Consent Questionnaire response. Take the questionnaire from the insurance plan for the policy. The consent document is signed by the doctor and the patient. Send the response as a QuestionnaireResponse, referenced from a supportingInfo entry with category INF.

PAYR-1257.title: Payment already initiated for the case
PAYR-1257.meaning: The payer refused a cancellation because payment for the case has already started.
fix: Do not resend the cancellation. You cannot cancel this case.
Follow the case through payment.

PAYR-1258.title: Payment already cleared for the case
PAYR-1258.meaning: The payer refused a cancellation because payment for the case has already been made.
fix: Do not resend the cancellation. You cannot cancel this case.
Record the case as paid.

PAYR-1259.title: Newborn date of birth missing
PAYR-1259.meaning: The payer refused a newborn case because the baby's date of birth was not sent.
fix: Add the baby's date of birth to the child's Patient.
Attach the proof of date of birth: category DOB, code BCF for a birth certificate, or DCB for a government hospital discharge card.
Resend the request.

PAYR-1260.title: Newborn date of birth is in the future
PAYR-1260.meaning: The payer refused a newborn case because the baby's date of birth was later than today.
fix: Correct the child's date of birth. Check it against the proof of date of birth you attach.
Resend the request.

PAYR-1261.title: Newborn details are not valid
PAYR-1261.meaning: The payer refused a newborn case because the newborn details failed its checks.
fix: The parent, mother or father, is the primary Patient.
The parent's Patient links the child's Patient through link, with type refer and other pointing at the child.
The child's Patient carries gender, date of birth and name.
Proof of date of birth: category DOB, code BCF for a birth certificate, or DCB for a government hospital discharge card.

PAYR-1262.title: Newborn gender missing
PAYR-1262.meaning: The payer refused a newborn case because the baby's gender was not sent.
fix: Add the gender to the child's Patient. Use a value from the administrative gender value set, https://hl7.org/fhir/R4/valueset-administrative-gender.html.
Resend the request.

PAYR-1263.title: Newborn documents missing
PAYR-1263.meaning: The payer refused a newborn case because a mandatory document for the baby was not attached.
fix: Proof of date of birth: category DOB, code BCF for a birth certificate, or DCB for a government hospital discharge card.
A supporting attachment that justifies a bill in the parent's name as Baby of <parent name>.
Every document the coverage eligibility auth-requirements response lists for the procedures.

PAYR-1264.title: Newborn documents missing
PAYR-1264.meaning: The payer refused a newborn case because a mandatory document for the baby was not attached.
fix: Proof of date of birth: category DOB, code BCF for a birth certificate, or DCB for a government hospital discharge card.
A supporting attachment that justifies a bill in the parent's name as Baby of <parent name>.
Every document the coverage eligibility auth-requirements response lists for the procedures.

PAYR-1265.title: Newborn documents missing
PAYR-1265.meaning: The payer refused a newborn case because a mandatory document for the baby was not attached.
fix: Proof of date of birth: category DOB, code BCF for a birth certificate, or DCB for a government hospital discharge card.
A supporting attachment that justifies a bill in the parent's name as Baby of <parent name>.
Every document the coverage eligibility auth-requirements response lists for the procedures.

PAYR-1266.title: Newborn documents missing
PAYR-1266.meaning: The payer refused a newborn case because a mandatory document for the baby was not attached.
fix: Proof of date of birth: category DOB, code BCF for a birth certificate, or DCB for a government hospital discharge card.
A supporting attachment that justifies a bill in the parent's name as Baby of <parent name>.
Every document the coverage eligibility auth-requirements response lists for the procedures.

PAYR-1267.title: Active newborn preauthorisation at your hospital
PAYR-1267.meaning: The payer refused a newborn case because the beneficiary already has an active newborn preauthorisation at your hospital.
fix: Find the active preauthorisation by the reference number in the message.
Cancel it, or raise its claim.
Resend your request.

PAYR-1268.title: Active newborn preauthorisation at another hospital
PAYR-1268.meaning: The payer refused a newborn case because the beneficiary already has an active newborn preauthorisation at another hospital.
fix: Ask the hospital named in the message to cancel its active preauthorisation, or to raise its claim.
Resend your request once that hospital confirms.

PAYR-1269.title: Newborn is older than 6 years
PAYR-1269.meaning: The payer refused a newborn case because the child's date of birth is more than 6 years ago.
fix: Check the date of birth against the proof you attach. Correct it if it is wrong.
A newborn case is for a child aged 6 or under who has no Member ID yet. If the child is older than 6 years, do not send the case as a newborn case.
Resend the request.

PAYR-1270.title: Item LM100 sent on a preauthorisation
PAYR-1270.meaning: The payer refused the preauthorisation because it included item LM100, which belongs only on a claim.
fix: Remove the LM100 item from the preauthorisation.
Send LM100 only on the claim, when the discharge qualifies.
Resend the preauthorisation.

PAYR-1271.title: Consent questionnaire answer missing
PAYR-1271.meaning: The payer refused a new preauthorisation because a question in the consent questionnaire had no answer.
fix: Answer every question in the questionnaire, as the insurance plan for the policy defines it.

Or send biometric authentication. Authenticate the patient by fingerprint, iris or face. Pass the user token from the verification as a header on the preauthorisation. The token is valid for 30 minutes.
Resend the request.

PAYR-1272.title: Biometric user token is not valid
PAYR-1272.meaning: The payer refused the request because the patient's biometric user token was not valid.
fix: Authenticate the patient again by fingerprint, iris or face.
Send the new user token with the preauthorisation.
If biometric capture keeps failing, send the Authentication Consent Questionnaire response instead.

PAYR-1273.title: Questionnaire not found for the selection
PAYR-1273.meaning: The payer refused the request because a questionnaire response pointed at a questionnaire it could not find.
fix: Put the exact questionnaire URL in QuestionnaireResponse.questionnaire. Take it from the insurance plan or the coverage eligibility auth-requirements response.
Refresh your stored insurance plan if it is out of date.
Resend the request.

PAYR-1301.title: A claim already exists for this case
PAYR-1301.meaning: The payer refused a new claim because a claim has already been raised for the same case.
fix: Do not raise a second claim for the case. Wait for the payer's response to the first claim on /v1/claim/on_submit.
If the payer queried the first claim, answer the query on the same claim. Follow answer a payer query on a claim.
If the payer rejected the claim and you dispute the decision, follow ask the payer to reprocess a claim.
If your records show no earlier claim, search your submission log for an earlier 202 Accepted on the same case number.

PAYR-1302.title: No approved preauthorisation for this case
PAYR-1302.meaning: The payer refused a new claim because it found no approved preauthorisation for the case.
fix: Put the identifier of the approved preauthorisation in Claim.identifier, or reference the preAuthRef from its ClaimResponse.
Submit the claim only after the preauthorisation is approved and treatment is complete. Follow submit a preauthorisation first.
Set x-hcx-recipient_code to the processingID from the get policies response, not the PayerID.

PAYR-1303.title: No active claim to update for this case
PAYR-1303.meaning: The payer refused your query response because the case has no open claim to update.
fix: Reuse the original Claim.identifier in the query response.
Check the payer's last response on the claim. If it was response.complete, the claim is closed and a query response will not be accepted.
To dispute a closed claim that was rejected, follow ask the payer to reprocess a claim.
If no claim exists yet, submit one first. Follow submit a claim after discharge.

PAYR-1304.title: The claim for this case is not under query
PAYR-1304.meaning: The payer refused your query response because it has not queried the claim for this case.
fix: Send a query response only after a query arrives. Read outcome and the adjudication reason code together: partial with queried is a query.
Reuse the Claim.identifier of the queried claim.
Set x-hcx-workflow_id to the claim query response code from workflow codes, not a preauthorisation code.

PAYR-1305.title: The use case is not valid for this case
PAYR-1305.meaning: The payer refused the request because the use case it declares is not valid for the case.
fix: Set Claim.use to claim on every claim bundle.
If you send x-hcx-use_case, use the claim value for the step: New for a first claim, Resubmit for a resubmission.
Declare a resubmission only for a case that already has a claim.

PAYR-1306.title: The procedure is not in the preauthorisation request
